t: This is the memorial plaque to Jack Cornwell. John Travers Cornwell, known as Boy Cornwell, is remembered for his gallantry at the Battle of Jutland during the First World War. He died at only sixteen, and was awarded the Victoria Cross after his death. That is the highest award for gallantry in the face of the enemy that British and Commonwealth forces can receive. Only two recipients were younger, Andrew Fitzgibbon and Thomas Flynn. Take a moment to read the plaque.
